description: Header file defining the RtXcastConnector class for managing remote communication with rtRemote, including initialization, shutdown, application state management, and callbacks.

classes.name: RtXcastConnector
classes.description: Connector class for interacting with xdial client via rtRemote, managing remote communication, callbacks, and singleton instance.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes rtRemote communication with rtDial server.

methods.name: applicationStateChanged
methods.description: Handles application state changes, reporting to rtRemote server.

methods.name: enableCastService
methods.description: Enables or disables cast service discovery.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of RtXcastConnector.

methods.name: connectToRemoteService
methods.description: Establishes connection to remote rtRemote service.
